item.create_biotech.surgery_guide.toolti: A player's guide to the _Surgical Table_ and the _Bionic Creatures_ it makes.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.title: Surgical Table and Bionic Creature Player Guide
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.1: This feature is unfinished, and future releases will change it in ways that are not compatible with older versions, so playing with it in a long-term survival world is not recommended. It is a fairly large system whose Ponder scenes are not finished yet; this guide covers how it actually plays.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.2: You can use the Surgical Table to take Slime Mimic Creatures apart and reassemble them. Parts can be rearranged and mixed with parts from other creatures; once joints are fitted, the head, arms and legs can move. Pack the finished body into a box and release it to get the bionic creature "Slime?".
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.3: How the result performs depends on which parts you keep, how you assemble them, and where the joints go. Some donors have properties of their own (unfinished).
create_biotech.surgery_guide.intro.4: This system may conflict with client-side mods that modify entity models on their own.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.quick_start: 1. Grow a Mimic Creature with a Petri Dish; see the Petri Dish's Ponder scene for details.
2. Capture the Mimic Creature in a Cardboard Box.
3. Lay out Surgical Tables. Tables that are horizontally adjacent and at the same height join into a single work surface, and a complex body needs a large one.
4. Place the box holding the Mimic Creature on the surface to turn it into parts. This cannot be undone.
5. Cut, arrange and glue the parts you need, then fit the joints.
6. Pack the whole body with an empty Cardboard Box, hold Alt to inspect its stats, and sneak-right-click to release the result.
7. A finished "Slime?" can also go back on the Surgical Table for further work.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.1: While holding the Surgical Kit, hold the kit key (Alt by default), move the cursor onto the tool you want, and release the key to switch to it.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.2: Tools inside the kit only work on a Surgical Table; the matching standalone tools and materials can be used directly as well.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.3: Aim at a part, seam, joint or tabletop and the screen shows which actions are currently available and which keys they need.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.basics.4: Powering any Surgical Table of a connected work surface with redstone temporarily shows each part's original creature appearance, which helps identify where it came from; it does not change the assembled result.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.note: For a tool's exact keys, selection order and current step, follow the on-screen prompt while your crosshair is on a target. The table below only describes what each tool is for.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.shear: First dismantle and recover any joint under the crosshair; otherwise, cut a creature's original seams or the glue joins you added later; also dissolves or detaches a fused combination as a whole.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.shove: Discard the whole connected part you are aiming at and recover some slime balls; can also clear every part intersecting one tabletop.
Bond the selected positions of two parts together. Smart Super Glue also lets you nudge the position and tilt before confirming. In the third Smart Super Glue stage, rotate and translate freely, then right-click to validate contact and space. Translation is limited to four blocks from the initial aligned position. Failed validation keeps the preview available for adjustment.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.honey: Fuse the entire connected part you are aiming at into one rigid combination, which is handy for building a torso, an arm or a leg segment first. Cutting and joint calculations treat that combination as a single part.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.slime: Add a glue seam between two cubes that already touch but are not yet directly connected.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.symme: Mirror an existing part across the centre face you pick, following the glue relations already there, and glue it in place; it does not conjure up new parts.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.wrenc: Right-click a cube to start a single-cube adjustment preview; Ctrl + right-click previews adjusting all connected parts around its center. Aim at different faces to choose the axis. Controls are shared with Smart Super Glue: scroll translates 1/32 block; Ctrl + scroll rotates 5°. Translation is limited to four blocks. Shift + right-click aligns and grounds the group with the smallest rotation, validating and committing immediately without another confirmation. Ordinary adjustment preview changes are neither validated nor saved until you right-click again to confirm. A failed confirmation leaves the preview available for adjustment. Left-click discards every preview change and restores the original pose. A single-cube adjustment only needs to retain one original connection; connections that no longer touch are removed when the rotation is committed. Joint connections must remain intact and cannot be automatically severed.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.tempo: Hold one whole connected part aside, to reposition it or move it to another Surgical Table. Hold Ctrl while placing to use the selected ground orientation (down by default); hold Ctrl before picking it up to preview its translucent blue ground plane. Hold Ctrl and scroll while placing to cycle through six ground orientations.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.empty: Pack the whole connected part you are aiming at as a finished creature. Anything left unattached stays on the table.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.tools.cost: Cutting, gluing and honey-fusing normally cost no materials and no kit durability; a server owner can change that rule. Fitting a joint consumes the joint item, which you get back when you remove it.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.intr: Joints can be fitted to make parts move. While holding a joint, hold the surgical kit key, move to a type on the wheel, then release. The close-up at the chain's lower right shows the selected type. Joints decide which parts count as a head, an arm or a leg, and give them the matching abilities and animation.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.neck: Turns the head to follow where the body looks; one body can fit at most one.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.shou: Marks the moving part as an arm so it joins in on attacks; at most eight.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.elbo: Bends the forearm along with the upper arm; it can attach to exactly one shoulder joint.
Marks the moving part as a leg so it joins the gait; at most eight.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.knee: Bends the lower leg through each stride; it can attach to exactly one hip joint.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.rule: A first-level joint (neck, shoulder, hip) cannot be chained below another first-level joint, and one moving part cannot be driven by more than one joint. A joint only fits between two parts that are directly connected but not honey-fused into the same combination.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.joints.anim: Joints adjust their animation to the shape you actually built.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats: How the Finished Stats Are Decided
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats.1: Maximum health follows the final model's non-overlapping volume, with diminishing gains as the body grows. Movement and attacks follow the final shape and working joints; donor stats are not inherited.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats.2: This part is still unfinished; suggestions are welcome in the comments on the mod and the videos.
create_biotech.surgery_guide.stats.inspe: With the bionic creature packed into a box, hold Alt to expand its details. It lists maximum health, damage (DPS), movement speed, armour, knockback-related values, working limbs, and donor-tissue traits. The DPS shown is a baseline that ignores weapons, enchantments, status effects and where exactly a target is hit.

Movement speed is affected by whether the legs reach the ground, how long they are, whether they have knees, and how much of the whole body they make up. Likewise, arm length, arm count and elbow joints affect attack reach, speed and swing area.

create_biotech.ponder.creeper_blast_cham: Creeper Blast Chamber Assembly
The structure supports 3 different sizes.
The center of the top face must be a Mechanical Press.
The center of the bottom face must be a Bio Packager.
The frame of the structure is built from Explosion-Proof Casing.
The center block of any side face, except the top and bottom, can be replaced with Blast-Proof Glass.
In addition, every structure must include a Blast Chamber Core.
It also needs two Explosion-Proof Item Vaults of any size; connected vaults count as one.
After the structure forms, the top edges are automatically replaced with Encased Chain Drives.
You can use a Wrench to swap between casings and chain drives, but enough chain drives must remain to power every press.
Creeper Blast Chamber Overload
The Creeper Blast Chamber can handle speeds up to 128 RPM.
Any speed above 128 RPM will send it into an overloaded state.
Do not overload it for too long, unless you want an explosion big enough to destroy your base!
Creeper Blast Chamber High-Pressure Implosion
Feed a high-pressure creeper into the chamber...
to switch recipes into High-Pressure Implosion mode.
High-Pressure Implosion mode has its own recipes and no longer runs Crushing Wheel recipes.
Of course, overload explosions also become much more powerful.
Creeper Blast Chamber Operation
The Blast Chamber Core can input and output creepers using cardboard boxes.
The largest blast chamber can have up to 9 creepers working at once.
Apply rotational force...
For each creeper inside, the chamber takes one batch of items from the input vault, runs the matching Crushing Wheel recipe, and outputs the result to the output vault.
Hold right-click on a vault to switch it between input and output.
Creeper Blast Chamber Introduction
This is a Creeper Blast Chamber.
It can process Crushing Wheel recipes efficiently in bulk.
Or... are you looking for something more explosive?
create_biotech.ponder.bone_ratchet.text_: The Bone Ratchet only accepts rotation in one direction.
When given stress from the opposite direction, it jams the entire kinetic network.
create_biotech.ponder.evoker_enchanting_: This is an Evoker Enchanting Chamber.
It can turn copied enchanted books into usable enchanted books.
Supply it with the experience needed for enchanting through an Experience Pump.
The higher the total enchantment level, the more experience and time it requires.
This is a simple enchantment production line.
Mark an enchanted book on the side...
It will process the book below into an Enchanted Book (Copy).
Whether it is working or not, the printer needs a water supply to keep the squid alive.
create_biotech.ponder.magma_belt_connect: Using a blower to smelt items takes a lot of space.
Use a Magma Cube Belt instead.
It automatically smelts items above it, taking the same amount of time as a blower.
It does not have a blower's smelting protection, so remember to remove the item before it burns a second time!
create_biotech.ponder.slime_clutch.text_: The Slime Clutch automatically disengages when the input stress cannot drive the entire kinetic network, without affecting the rest of the network.
It automatically re-engages when enough stress is available.

create_biotech.ponder.universal_joint.te: The Universal Joint can transmit rotational force between any two nearby points.
The other node must be within range. Moving structures stretch the shaft; it shifts to the clutch overload colour and snaps when overextended.
create_biotech.ponder.experience_pump_s_: The output side provides experience to compatible fluid endpoints.
It can also output experience to fluid tanks and other fluid containers.
The output side cannot turn experience directly into items.
You need to feed the experience into Budding Experience...
Catalyzed mature Experience Clusters drop naturally and store far more experience than Experience Nuggets.
create_biotech.ponder.experience_pump_sc: The Experience Pump can transfer experience between its two ends.
The input side accepts many forms of experience.
Experience in tanks or fluid pipes...

create_biotech.ponder.slime_belt_connect: The Slime Belt can transport items like a normal belt.
The difference is that items are not thrown off the end, but continue moving onto the back side of the belt.
The Slime Belt can also move items vertically.
Connected Slime Belts can form a loop.

create_biotech.ponder.shulker_packager.t: Shulker Packagers work much like regular Packagers.
The difference is that they automatically teleport their packages over short distances.
Before placing a Shulker Packager, right-click another Shulker Packager (or regular Packager) to select an output target.
After receiving a request, the Shulker Packager teleports the package to its selected target.
Shulker Packagers are suited for short-range transport; for long-range transport, use Cargo Allay Stations, Package Frogports, Trains, Postboxes, and similar options.
Check their Ponder screens to learn how they behave.
create_biotech.ponder.shulker_teleporter: Shulker Teleport Stations can teleport players, creatures, or dropped items between two stations.
Set this station's address and its target address in the interface.
Once sealed, entities inside are teleported to the target station.
create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_s_e7373: Mimic and bionic creatures drop no items when killed, but split into living Slimes

Then use an Encased Fan and Soul Campfire to haunt it
This transforms the mimic creature into a normal mob
create_biotech.ponder.petri_dish_scene_1: Slime Petri Dishes can be used to cultivate mimic creatures
Insert a Living Mechanism into the Petri Dish...
Then pipe in Liquid Living Slime...
The Liquid Living Slime mimics a nearby mob and grows
Mobs with more maximum health require more Liquid Living Slime to mimic
create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_s_21db7: Allay Couriers can target players for delivery.
Use "@player" in the address field to target a player.
create_biotech.ponder.allay_port_scene_1: Cargo Allay Stations can be used to deliver packages remotely.
Set this station's address in its interface.
Cargo Allay Stations automatically pull packages from the Packager or container below and dispatch an Allay Courier to the specified Cargo Allay Station.
The interface lets you configure whether the Allay Courier returns after delivery.
Allay Couriers have no delivery range limit and can even travel between dimensions.
However, make sure all stations involved are in loaded chunks.

create_biotech.jei.trait.donors.scroll: Scroll to change pages. Donors are identified using the current server's trait rules.
create_biotech.jei.trait.donors.incomple: Could not inspect %s creature types; this list may be incomplete.
create_biotech.jei.trait.open: View recipes or uses to read about this trait
create_biotech.jei.trait.rule.presence.d: Retain matching carrier tissue within the effective region
create_biotech.jei.trait.carrier.head: head
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.wool_: At least one adult sheep body supports any number of adult sheep body-wool parts across the whole creature
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.udder: Adult cow and mooshroom udders are interchangeable: pair with any cow body for milk, or any mooshroom body for milk and mushroom stew without extra mushroom parts. Adult goats only need a body. Udders and bodies may remain anywhere in the assembly
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.shell: One adult body in the torso supports multiple adult shell parts from the same donor species
A Shulker needs only its lid in the torso, without a base; an Armadillo needs both its outer shell and body
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.compl: Body and both ribcages from the same donor species must remain in the torso
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.head_: Head core and at least one tendril from the same donor species must remain in one head
Head core and mouth from the same donor species must remain in one head
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.wings: 2+ qualifying wings; body volume ≤16× wing volume
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.numer: The unrounded aggregate must reach 0.1; effective values use one decimal place
create_biotech.jei.trait.fire_immune.eff: Immune to fire and lava damage; never catches fire.
create_biotech.jei.trait.fire_resistance: As coverage rises, fire damage reduction rises from 0%% to 100%%.
create_biotech.jei.trait.water_sensitive: Takes 1 damage every 0.5s in water, rain or bubble columns.
create_biotech.jei.trait.freeze_immune.e: Cannot be frozen by powder snow; immune to freezing damage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.freeze_resistan: As coverage rises, freezing damage reduction rises from 0%% to 100%%.
create_biotech.jei.trait.freeze_vulnerab: As coverage rises, freezing damage taken rises from 1× to 5×.
create_biotech.jei.trait.sun_sensitive.e: Catches fire for 8s in direct sunlight. A helmet blocks this but loses durability.
create_biotech.jei.trait.moisture_depend: 2400 ticks of moisture, replenished by water, rain and bubbles. When dry, attempts 1 damage each tick as dolphins do.
Takes 1 fire damage every 0.5s in hot biomes where Snow Golems melt.
create_biotech.jei.trait.inverted_healin: Instant Health harms it; Instant Damage heals it.
create_biotech.jei.trait.no_breathing.ef: Never drowns; suppresses Cannot Breathe on Land.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wingless_flight: Can fly; immune to fall damage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.projectile_defl: Reflects incoming projectiles, except wind charges.
create_biotech.jei.trait.contact_retalia: While stationary, retaliates against direct living attackers for a fixed 2 thorns damage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.dry_suffocation: Out of water, air falls from 300 to −20; takes 2 damage and resets to zero. Water and bubbles refill it.
create_biotech.jei.trait.tameable.effect: Tame with a Slime Ball. Follows and fights for its owner; owner interactions toggle sitting unless another action takes priority. Overrides Tameable (Livestock), hiding and disabling it.
create_biotech.jei.trait.livestock_tamea: Tame with a Slime Ball to establish ownership. Living Slime heals it; riding and cargo access are owner-only. Keeps wandering, production and self-defense, without following, teleporting to or fighting for its owner, or accepting sit commands. Hidden and disabled by Tameable (Pet).
create_biotech.jei.trait.vibration_sense: Tracks an unseen target through its vibrations within 12 blocks.
Uses the enderman water path cost of −1.
create_biotech.jei.trait.deterrence.effe: Mobs within 8 blocks that fear the donor flee, e.g. Creepers from Cats.
Fall distance reduced by 3 blocks; fall damage halved.
create_biotech.jei.trait.lava_walk.effec: Can stand on lava, but does not grant fire immunity.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wall_climb.effe: Climbs walls like a spider, continuing toward pursuit or follow targets beyond ground paths.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wing_flight.eff: Enables flight with donor wing animations. Ordinary arms remain available for attacks.
create_biotech.jei.trait.effect_attack.e: Poison follows bee difficulty scaling; Wither lasts 200 ticks; unarmed Hunger lasts 140 × integer local effective difficulty ticks.
create_biotech.jei.trait.shell_defense.e: Damage triggers shell defense for 4 seconds by default; further hits refresh it. Movement stops while attacks remain available. Damage reduction equals the volume of valid shell-defense parts divided by the sum of all retained cube volumes throughout the body, counting overlapping volumes separately.
Gains the donors' status effect immunities; each effect's coverage is checked separately.
create_biotech.jei.trait.natural_armor.e: As coverage rises, armor rises, matching the donor's armor at 50%% coverage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.knockback_resis: As coverage rises, knockback resistance rises, reaching 15%% + the donor's value at 50%% coverage (max 100%%).
create_biotech.jei.trait.passive_regener: Uses the highest-valued 50% of tissue; heals half the per-second value every 10 ticks.
create_biotech.jei.trait.enchant_vulnera: Each sensitivity separately requires 50% coverage. Matching weapon or projectile enchantments deal +2.5 damage per level; direct Bane of Arthropods hits also apply Slowness IV.
create_biotech.jei.trait.hunting_instinc: Hunts non-player prey according to donor relations, respecting ownership, distance, environment and hunting cooldowns. Excludes owners and allies.
create_biotech.jei.trait.pack_alert.effe: When hurt by a living attacker, alerts bionics with the same owner, or unowned bionics with this trait, within 35 blocks and 10 vertically. Sitting companions do not respond.
create_biotech.jei.trait.attack_knockbac: Each arm averages its highest-valued 50% of tissue volume. Hits add knockback equal to half that arm's value. Tooltips show the strongest arm.
create_biotech.jei.trait.door_handling.e: Donor tissue installed as an arm enables vanilla door breaking on Hard, taking 240 ticks.
Multiplies falling speed by 0.6 each tick and prevents fall damage. Shares the wing-flight animation, hinging along the intersection seam between the wing and its connected part. No lift requirement; hidden and inactive while winged or wingless flight is active.
create_biotech.jei.trait.strong_jump.eff: Adds 0.2 to jump velocity and permits ground paths onto two-block ledges. Enables charged jumps at 0.4–1.0 strength while ridden. Any Breeze body part can supply this tissue; other donors use their leg carriers.
create_biotech.jei.trait.block_attachmen: Retain a Shulker base anywhere in the body to attach to an adjacent supporting block face. Aligns the actual bottom face, rotating the entire creature and its bounding boxes when the base is tilted. Movement and orientation lock only while attached. If the attached face becomes invalid, Ender Teleport triggers one immediate teleport attempt; otherwise attachment restrictions lift and the nearest valid surface within one block of the base contact point is detected automatically. Failed or cancelled teleports also release restrictions and resume detection. Does not grant a Shulker's solid entity collision. With multiple bases, uses the lowest Y in the assembly before attachment rotation.
create_biotech.jei.trait.shoulder_riding: At least 50% Parrot tissue across the whole body enables riding the owner's shoulder. Once tamed and standing, touch the grounded owner to perch; wait 100 ticks after spawning or dismounting. Each shoulder holds one creature. Falling, water, flight, sleeping or powder snow dismounts it under vanilla rules, preserving its full assembly and equipment.
Enderman and shulker tissue jointly grant enderman projectile evasion, environmental-damage teleporting and distant pursuit.
create_biotech.jei.trait.magic_resistanc: Multiplies witch-resistant damage (magic, indirect magic, sonic boom and thorns) by 1 - 0.85 × whole-body coverage.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wither_shield.e: At half health or below, prevents direct damage from arrows, tridents and wind charges.
create_biotech.jei.trait.launch_strike.e: A hit with an arm containing golem hands, dragon wings or goat/adult hoglin/adult zoglin horns adds 0.4 × (1 - knockback resistance) vertical velocity.
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.slow_: At least %s effective wing arms; no lift requirement
create_biotech.trait.hunt_target.attacka: attackable creatures (except zoglins, creepers and players)
create_biotech.jei.trait.rideable.effect: One valid back part from a saddleable donor grants this trait, with no coverage or minimum volume requirement. Saddle that part, then click it with an empty hand to mount; all donors allow direct control. Only body parts from vanilla donors provide this trait. Modded donors use back-part names, falling back to the clicked part if none are recognized. Camel backs grant two seats and a dash; Strong Jump enables charged jumps. Flight and swimming follow pitch, with jump to ascend. Tameable creatures must be tamed and only their owner may ride.
create_biotech.jei.trait.cargo_chest.eff: Use a chest to install storage; sneak with an empty hand to open it. Donkey/mule: 15 slots; llama: donor Strength × 3. Sneak with an axe to remove an empty chest. Drops the chest and contents on death. Tamed creatures restrict access to their owner.
create_biotech.jei.trait.loot_pickup.eff: Every 10 ticks, picks up better melee weapons within one block for the hand with the required tissue, dropping replaced equipment. Respects mob griefing hooks. The owner can also sneak-use a weapon to hand it over.
create_biotech.jei.trait.sonic_boom.effe: Targets visible or tracked by vibration within 15 horizontal and 20 vertical blocks. Charges for 34 ticks, deals 10 sonic damage and knockback; action lasts 60 ticks, followed by a 40-tick cooldown. Ribcages animate with its own charge state. Melee strikes also reset that cooldown.
create_biotech.jei.trait.roar.effect: When a melee strike is blocked, has a 50% chance to be stunned for 40 ticks, then roar after 10 more ticks: 6 damage and strong knockback to non-allies within four blocks. Otherwise immediately pushes the blocker.
create_biotech.jei.trait.head_projectile: Fires native projectiles from the head tissue centroid; intelligence selects among available variants. Uses donor ranges, charge times, bursts and cooldowns. Projectiles and area effects skip the owner and allies; explosions and ignition respect mob griefing. Dragon breath clouds can be bottled.
create_biotech.jei.trait.guardian_beam.e: Within 16 blocks, warms up for 10 ticks then channels for 80 ticks (elder: 60). Losing sight interrupts it. Deals 1 magic damage (+2 on Hard, +2 for elder), then 6 melee damage (elder: 8). Normal guardian requires a distance above three blocks.
create_biotech.jei.trait.spellcasting.ef: Fangs: charges for 40 ticks, followed by a 60-tick cooldown; two nearby rings or 16 fangs in a line. Potions: throws within 10 blocks every 60 ticks, selecting slowness, poison, weakness or harming. Effects skip the owner and allies.
create_biotech.jei.trait.self_destruct.e: Unowned creatures swell when a target comes within three blocks, shrinking beyond seven blocks or without sight. Explodes after 30 ticks with power 3 (6 when lightning-charged). Owned creatures only explode when ignited by their owner. Ignition is irreversible; no splitting on death. Active effects leave a cloud.
create_biotech.jei.trait.snow_trail.effe: Leaves snow at the four corners underfoot where it can survive, without a temperature check. Respects mob griefing and block protection hooks.
create_biotech.jei.trait.pollination.eff: Presence-based: retain a bee body in the torso; no legs required. Each valid bee body independently attempts crop growth and supplies up to 10 growths per pollen collection. Uses bee collection timing and crop tags. Nectar appearance follows the mimic’s own state.
create_biotech.jei.trait.milkable.effect: Each interaction fills one matching container regardless of part count. The tooltip lists the available products after Milkable. No cooldown; supports deployers.
create_biotech.jei.trait.wool_shearing.e: Each wool part independently yields 1–3 wool in its own donor color, with colors counted separately. Wool visibility follows the mimic’s sheared state; grass eating regrows it together.
create_biotech.jei.trait.egg_laying.effe: Presence: requires adult chicken bodies in the torso. Each valid body lays one egg per 6000–11999-tick production cycle. Outputs add together; the timer persists with the entity.
Each valid shell sheds one scute per 6000–11999-tick production cycle. One brushing yields one scute per valid shell and costs 16 durability. Shedding does not hide shells.
create_biotech.jei.trait.condition.body_: Body volume of at least 0.5 cubic blocks
